mistakes.text: If he started earlier, he would miss the mist.
mistakes.normalized: if he started earlier he would miss the mist
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ide o minulosť, ktorá sa nestala, preto Third Conditional: „had started … would have missed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Jde o minulost, která se nestala, proto Third Conditional: „had started … would have missed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This is about an unreal past, so use the Third Conditional: “had started … would have missed”.

mistakes.text: If he would have started earlier, he would have missed the mist.
mistakes.normalized: if he would have started earlier he would have missed the mist
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ nepatrí „would“; v Third Conditional je tam Past Perfect: „if he had started“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ nepatří „would“; ve Third Conditional je tam Past Perfect: „if he had started“.
mistakes.feedback_en: No “would” after “if”; the Third Conditional uses the Past Perfect there: “if he had started”.

mistakes.text: If he had started earlier, he would miss the mist.
mistakes.normalized: if he had started earlier he would miss the mist
mistakes.feedback_sk: Hmla bola v minulosti, preto aj následok v Third Conditional: „would have missed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Mlha byla v minulosti, proto i následek ve Third Conditional: „would have missed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The mist was in the past, so the result also needs the Third Conditional: “would have missed”.

mistakes.text: If he had started more early, he would have missed the mist.
mistakes.normalized: if he had started more early he would have missed the mist
mistakes.feedback_en: The comparative of “early” is “earlier”, not “more early”.

mistakes.text: If he had started earlier, he would had missed the mist.
mistakes.normalized: if he had started earlier he would had missed the mist
mistakes.kind: would had instead of would have
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „would“ patrí vždy „have“, nie „had“: „would have missed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „would“ patří vždy „have“, ne „had“: „would have missed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “would” always use “have”, not “had”: “would have missed”.
